svg.title: Compare Niche Gross Spread, Not Headline Billings
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-niche-gross-spread-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Niche Gross Spread, Not Headline Billings; subtitle: Five illustrative lane archetypes use the same $2,000 shipper invoice.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are brokerage gross-margin percentages: (shipper invoice minus carrier purchase) divided by shipper invoice. These are hypothetical quoting comparisons, not market yield estimates or net-profit forecasts. Payment terms and accessorial treatment are held constant.; caption: A wider spread can compensate for harder coverage, cargo exposure, or after-hours labor. Compare contribution after service costs rather than treating the highest bar as the best niche.; stages: label: Predictable dry-van replenishment; value: 12% gross margin; $240 retained spread; numeric value: 12.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,760 carrier purchase leaves $240 before overhead. Repeat appointments can reduce touch time, while competitive bids compress spread.; label: Regional industrial replacement parts; value: 14% gross margin; $280 retained spread; numeric value: 14.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,720 carrier purchase leaves $280 before overhead. Confirm receiving hours and accessorial recovery before accepting urgent orders.; label: Scheduled packaged-goods truckload; value: 15% gross margin; $300 retained spread; numeric value: 15.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,700 carrier purchase leaves $300 before overhead. This illustrative spread matches the Base waterfall's carrier-cost assumption.; label: Appointment-sensitive refrigerated freight; value: 17% gross margin; $340 retained spread; numeric value: 17.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,660 carrier purchase leaves $340 before overhead. Verify temperature instructions, equipment suitability, and relevant cargo coverage before tender.; label: Time-critical manufacturing recovery; value: 18% gross margin; $360 retained spread; numeric value: 18.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,640 carrier purchase leaves $360 before overhead. Price after-hours coordination and recovery capacity rather than assuming urgency creates free margin.

rect.title: label: Predictable dry-van replenishment; value: 12% gross margin; $240 retained spread; numeric value: 12.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,760 carrier purchase leaves $240 before overhead. Repeat appointments can reduce touch time, while competitive bids compress spread.

label: Regional industrial replacement parts; value: 14% gross margin; $280 retained spread; numeric value: 14.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,720 carrier purchase leaves $280 before overhead. Confirm receiving hours and accessorial recovery before accepting urgent orders.

label: Scheduled packaged-goods truckload; value: 15% gross margin; $300 retained spread; numeric value: 15.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,700 carrier purchase leaves $300 before overhead. This illustrative spread matches the Base waterfall's carrier-cost assumption.

label: Appointment-sensitive refrigerated freight; value: 17% gross margin; $340 retained spread; numeric value: 17.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,660 carrier purchase leaves $340 before overhead. Verify temperature instructions, equipment suitability, and relevant cargo coverage before tender.

label: Time-critical manufacturing recovery; value: 18% gross margin; $360 retained spread; numeric value: 18.0; detail: $2,000 shipper invoice less $1,640 carrier purchase leaves $360 before overhead. Price after-hours coordination and recovery capacity rather than assuming urgency creates free margin.
